issues.on_page: Employee Benefit 5690 Other non-revenue receipts 651,749 (p11) eliminated in the Reclassifications column (651,749) on the General Fund combining schedule (p5)
issues.issue: Internal money is counted twice in detail. The p5 Reclassifications column removes 651,749 from both Employee Benefit receipts and its spending (658,990 out of student support services: 651,749 eliminated, 7,241 moved to Instruction). The GF budget schedule lines (pp8-9, 6,455,828 of spending) already include the payments into Employee Benefit. Detail spending adds up to 8,833,980, against 8,182,231 on the statement (p3), a gap of exactly 651,749. The hidden-transfer rule calls for splitting with split_from p5: Employee Benefit receipt 651,749 becomes other financing (+), and its 2900 spending 658,990 becomes 7,241 spending (instruction per p5) plus 651,749 other financing (-). decision_needed raises the question, but the lines are recorded as revenue and spending.

issues.on_page: Employee Benefit spending 658,990: (658,990) reclassified out of Student support services, 7,241 of it into Instruction (623,762 = 482,058 + 134,463 + 7,241)
issues.issue: Same issue on the spending side: 651,749 of this line is the eliminated internal amount. Only 7,241 is real spending, and p5 counts that under Instruction.
